description: DiffCapAnalyzer is a Python package for cleaning battery-cycle data and quantifying peaks in differential-capacity curves. The JOSS paper connects those curves to electrochemical reactions and long-term cell degradation, and the own README describes peak locations, widths and amplitudes for charge and discharge cycles. Spatial coverage is the tested cell or batch, while temporal coverage is the cycling experiment. The public repository reports MIT. Peak trends can help calibrate battery degradation assumptions in storage or electric-vehicle simulations. A caveat is that a laboratory cycling protocol may not represent temperature, load and ageing conditions in an installed system. Peak fitting does not itself predict grid storage reliability. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own source were read without downloading test measurements or running the analysis.
name: DiffCapAnalyzer battery cycling analysis
